annotations.title: EUDR Deforestation Due Diligence Statement (DDS) TRACES NT Validator

description:
[EUDR deforestation due diligence statement (DDS) TRACES NT validator. Statutory audit, read-only, side-effect free]. Audits and validates operator Due Diligence Statements under Regulation (EU) 2023/1115 (EUDR) Articles 4, 8, and 9, verifying regulated commodity HS codes (Annex I), country risk tier, deforestation-free cutoff (31 Dec 2020), and legality of production.
Usage: Pass operator, commodity code, and compliance declarations to verify readiness for TRACES NT submission.
Returns: JSON object with { statementReference: string, operatorName: string, commodityCategory: string, isRegulatedCommodity: boolean, countryRiskTier: string, simplifiedDueDiligenceApplicable: boolean, cutoffDateCompliant: boolean, isDueDiligenceComplete: boolean, readinessVerdict: string, deficiencies: array, tracesPayloadPreview: object }.

activityType.description: Nature of commercial transaction under EUDR Art. 3

commodityCodeHs.description: Harmonized System (HS) tariff code (e.g. 1801 for cocoa, 0901 for coffee, 4407 for wood, 1201 for soya)

commodityDescription.description: Commercial trade description of the commodity/product

countryOfProductionIso2.description: 2-letter ISO country code where the commodity was produced/harvested

deforestationFreeCutoffVerifiedPost2020.description: Verification that commodity was produced on land that was not subject to deforestation or forest degradation after 31 December 2020

hasPolygonGeolocationProof.description: Whether geographic coordinates of all plots of land are documented (Art. 9(1)(d))

isProducedOnLegallyOwnedLand.description: Whether production complied with relevant local legislation on land tenure, labor, and environment (Art. 3(b))

operatorCountryIso2.description: 2-letter ISO country code of operator establishment

operatorName.description: Legal name of the operator or trader placing commodities on the EU market

operatorVatOrEori.description: Operator EORI number or national VAT tax identifier

totalQuantityKgOrUnits.description: Net mass in kilograms or supplementary volume units declared

name: eudr_due_diligence_statement_validator
title: EUDR Deforestation Due Diligence Statement (DDS) TRACES NT Validator
